identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a 'Clinical Zen' experience that balances professional trust with gamified engagement.

typography.installation: Import via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=Manrope:wght@400;600;700;800&display=swap');

colors.description: A calming, trust-inducing palette that reduces eye strain for tired medical professionals.

visual_enhancers.gradients: NO full-screen gradients. Use subtle mesh gradients in hero sections only.
visual_enhancers.borders: Rounded-xl or Rounded-2xl for a friendly, approachable feel.

swipe_deck.card: absolute w-full h-full bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-xl border border-slate-100 overflow-hidden cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing

layout_strategies.bento_box: bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300

SwipeCard.description: The core interaction element. Must use framer-motion for physics-based gestures.
SwipeCard.specs: Use `framer-motion`'s `useMotionValue` and `useTransform` for rotation and opacity. Threshold for swipe: 100px.

MatchDialog.description: Pop-up when a mutual match occurs. Needs confetti or high-energy animation.
MatchDialog.specs: Use `sonner` for simple notifications, but a full Dialog for matches.

DocumentUploader.description: Clean drag-and-drop zone with expiration tracking.
DocumentUploader.specs: Show progress bar. Color code expiration: Red (<30 days), Yellow (<60 days), Green (>60 days).

hero_section.description: Smiling doctor in white coat (Hero Image)

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE index.css: Replace the root variables with the 'Serene Pulse' palette provided in the colors section.
2. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to the top of index.css.
3. SWIPE LOGIC: Implement the swipe interface using `framer-motion`. Do NOT use a heavy external library if possible; a custom component is lighter and more customizable.
4. COMPATIBILITY SCORE: Display this as a circular progress ring on the card (e.g., '95% Match').
5. REFERENCE REQUESTS: Create a 'Blind Reference' flow. The requester sees status (Pending/Completed) but NOT the content.
6. NOTIFICATIONS: Use `sonner` for all toast notifications (matches, errors, success).
7. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every interactive element (buttons, inputs, cards) has a `data-testid` attribute.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Spacing: Use `p-8` or `p-12` for containers. Give content room to breathe.
Micro-interactions: Every button must scale down slightly on click (`active:scale-95`).
Glassmorphism: Use the provided glass classes for sticky headers and overlays.
No Gradients on Text: Keep text high-contrast and readable (WCAG AA).
